DialogueDictionary.$BlueLakeLookout01: NEEM: Why do you think this is called the "<![CDATA[<color=orange>Blue Lake</color>]]>"? It strikes me as gray, more than my color-blindness would cause.
DialogueDictionary.$BlueLakeLookout02: ADENA: It isn't remarkably blue, you're correct. Hypothesis: during its prime, it contained some strongly-colored chemical.
DialogueDictionary.$BlueLakeLookout03: NEEM: To help with cooling? I cannot imagine this structure didn't generate considerable heat.
DialogueDictionary.$BlueLakeLookout04: ADENA: Perhaps it was to make it pretty, and nothing more. I do not doubt our ancestors could make a harmless compound to achieve such an effect.
DialogueDictionary.$BlueLakeLookout05: ADENA: You, more than me, must know that what our predecessors saw as beautiful tells us more than their machinery (I won't deny it is a sight I much prefer myself, too).
DialogueDictionary.$BlueLakeLookout06: ADENA: Hypothesis confirmed! Although the substance has lost its color, it seems direct "sunlight" excites it back to life. Neem, my love, I insist you visit during (and just after) sunset!
DialogueDictionary.$BlueLakeScroll01: VERAT: Stem has recently asked me which constellation is the <![CDATA[<color=orange>Jelly</color>]]>, but I didn't remember either - could anyone explain it? For both their sake, and mine!
DialogueDictionary.$BlueLakeScroll02: OPHRYS: That one is symmetrical and thin, with tendrils following it along the sky. Stem could do with paying attention to my lectures!
DialogueDictionary.$BlueLakeScroll03: PHYSALIS: We all have our interests, sister (Not to mention, your lectures are hardly entertaining for someone their age!)
DialogueDictionary.$BlueLakeScroll04: VERAT: An update: Bao and Leersi (the other children) now ask me how to find it easily. I believe it's visible from the <![CDATA[<color=orange>Astronomical Site</color>]]> at around four after sunset, but I fear I might have misremembered.
DialogueDictionary.$BlueLakeScroll05: PHYSALIS: The <![CDATA[<color=orange>Jelly</color>]]> is visible at three after sunset! My sister (your mentor) has insisted I share some of her thoroughness in my knowledge...
DialogueDictionary.$BlueLakeScroll06: VERAT: My gratitude, Physalis I shall tell the children as soon as possible (And perhaps you could do with apprenticing under her too).
DialogueDictionary.$ExpoHall01: NEEM: This is it, then. We have explored this exhibit to its conclusion.
DialogueDictionary.$ExpoHall02: ADENA: It has been a delightful - if brief - tangent to our usual activities (Not to mention, a welcome excuse to have you all for myself, my captain).
DialogueDictionary.$ExpoHall03: NEEM: Adena! You know I dislike that title.
DialogueDictionary.$ExpoHall04: NEEM: I can’t imagine many in my profession have been fortunate enough to encounter a gift from time like this. A preserved museum! Two layers of the past, and accompanied by their image of the future. How incredible!
DialogueDictionary.$ExpoHall05: ADENA: What do you suppose we shall do with it? We’re not in need of its resources, and I know you couldn’t stand to see it dismantled, in any case.
DialogueDictionary.$ExpoHall06: NEEM: You’re right, my love. I suppose we ought to set it adrift again - no Nomai shall see it again, now that we’ve been forced to settle, but I must hope another species finds it and learns from it a snippet of our history.
DialogueDictionary.$ExpoHall07: ADENA: You surprise me, my dear: I imagined you would like to keep it for some time longer.
DialogueDictionary.$ExpoHall08: NEEM: The <![CDATA[<color=orange>past</color>]]> is good in the measure it advises the <![CDATA[<color=orange>future</color>]]>. We mustn't cling to it senselessly, especially when others may yet learn from it.
DialogueDictionary.$ExpoHall09: NEEM: But I will miss it all the same, this enchanted old ruin.
DialogueDictionary.$ExpoHall10: ADENA: A present]]> from time, you mean?
DialogueDictionary.$ExpoHall11: ADENA: If only your younger self, when you refused to do away with anything, saw you now...
DialogueDictionary.$ExpoOldestNomai01: -ess! Success! I repeat, success!]]> Virid has safely landed after completing a full orbital flight around our planet! I could not be happier: the first Nomai to circle our planet like the stars above!
DialogueDictionary.$ExpoOldestNomai02: We are all overjoyed. To think that one day, a Nomai will visit those stars; one day we will land on planets completely alien to us! The future brims with so many possibilities I can barely imagine it. How lucky and how strange, to see the first second of tomorrow.
DialogueDictionary.$ExpoPedestal: Oldest legible sample of Nomai writing, dated to around half a million years ago.
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiBase01: NEEM: Adena! Are you seeing this?
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiBase02: ADENA: I am, I am! I was so overjoyed with what we had explored already, it never occurred to me there would be twice as much!
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiBase03: NEEM: I shall visit the <![CDATA[<color=orange>Radiotelescope</color>]]> immediately - its chime has wholly caught my attention. I suspect you will wish to investigate the <![CDATA[<color=orange>Forest</color>]]>?
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiBase04: NEEM: Of note: I would very much enjoy to explore the structure above us, but it seems the way up has collapsed.
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiBase05: ADENA: Hypothesis: We could leverage momentum!
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiBase06: NEEM: You're far more adventurous than me, Adena.
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiBase07: NEEM: It is truly a wonderful place (Made more so by your company).
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiBase08: ADENA: You know me well; as well as I hope we will know this structure.
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiWallA01: OPHRYS: Please schedule more frequent irrigation around the Ancient City. A “dry” climate does not imply a complete lack of rain!
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiWallA02: VERAT: Of note: “Frequent irrigation” does not mean a constant downpour, either!
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiWallA03: GEUM: I quite like the wetter climate, for what it's worth.
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiWallA04: OPHRYS: Don't be a stick in the mud, Geum; especially now that you've ensured an overabundance of it. (I have corrected the schedule).
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiWallA05: ACANTHA: An update: Some visitors have requested some form of warning before the irrigation. I must agree with them: I much prefer to spend time teaching over drying my fur.
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiWallA06: PHYSALIS: I can make the <![CDATA[<color=orange>Radiotelescope</color>]]> emit a brief signal shortly before it. (Of note: I will temporarily install a post-hoc wire to the <![CDATA[<color=orange>Scheduling Room</color>]]> through the <![CDATA[<color=orange>Service Tunnels</color>]]>, until a more permanent implementation is possible)
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiWallA07: OPHRYS: Some months have passed since this. I feel it necessary (for my own satisfaction) to mention my brother has not implemented something more elegant.
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiWallA08: ACANTHA: A further update! Physalis' solution has proved popular - I have made the <![CDATA[<color=orange>Radiotelescope</color>]]> emit a signal shortly before all events.
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiWallB01: PHYSALIS: Acantha, while I was supervising the controls in the <![CDATA[<color=orange>Service Tunnels</color>]]>, I noticed some children observing me from the outside!
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiWallB02: ACANTHA: How wonderful! It's never too early to take an interest in physical engineering (As I'm sure you'll agree)! Perhaps one of them would be interested in an apprenticeship? They are approaching the age for one!
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiWallB03: PHYSALIS: Bao, perhaps, but Stem is currently interested in more than causing trouble.
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiWallB04: GEUM: These are difficult words to write: I have noticed the children observing me from inside]]> the Service Tunnels]]>.
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiWallB05: OPHRYS: Congratulations, brother! Your assessment of Stem seems to be entirely correct.
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiWallB06: VERAT: My apologies, everyone. Hypothesis: The clue hunt played by the children (designed by Stem) terminates at an overlooked entrance to the <![CDATA[<color=orange>Service Tunnels</color>]]>. (I am sure they did not enter through the main entrances.
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiWallBelowExpo01: VERAT: Geum, I wanted to visit the Exposition Hall, but it was completely closed. Was there a problem forcing it closed?
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiWallBelowExpo02: GEUM: Apologies, Verat: The Exposition Hall contains a very delicate relic, so for its preservation, the Hall will only open during events - that is to say, when it’s scheduled to open.
DialogueDictionary.$FomaiWallBelowExpo03: VERAT: I see! I hope to see this relic with my own three eyes soon, then.
DialogueDictionary.$Garden01: What should be done with the <![CDATA[<color=orange>Grand Exhibit</color>]]> after the Festival?
DialogueDictionary.$Garden02: OPHRYS: I propose it be dismantled and its materials reutilised for future projects.
DialogueDictionary.$Garden03: PHYSALIS: Sister! Do you lack a cardiovascular pump? How could you so easily argue to demolish what we all worked so carefully for?
DialogueDictionary.$Garden04: ACANTHA: She isn't without reason, Physalis. Dismantlement is certainly the most efficient use of the resources.
DialogueDictionary.$Garden05: OPHRYS: I am being pragmatic, brother: nothing should be wasted when it can be reutilized elsewhere.
DialogueDictionary.$Garden06: VERAT: We could empty it, and use it as grounds for environmental experiments and research.
DialogueDictionary.$Garden07: OPHRYS: It brings me pride to hear you say so, Verat. You have taken to our field better than I hypothesized.
DialogueDictionary.$Garden08: VERAT: I owe it only to your mentorship.
DialogueDictionary.$Garden09: GEUM: Hypothesis: I suspect it can be used as shelter, should a clan's Vessel be fatally wounded.
DialogueDictionary.$Garden10: ACANTHA: A grim hypothesis, Geum. I hope it is never tested.
DialogueDictionary.$Garden11: PHYSALIS: We should set it adrift, ideally on a course that avoids collision for the longest time possible.
DialogueDictionary.$Garden12: VERAT: What compels you to such an idea, Physalis? It's far too wasteful...
DialogueDictionary.$Garden13: PHYSALIS: I understand the concern, Verat; however, I ask that you think of the generations that will follow us. Imagine yourself discovering this structure - would you not wish to explore it as much as possible? It's a gift sent through the ages.
DialogueDictionary.$GravityRoom01: BAO: I wonder if there's any way inside...
DialogueDictionary.$GravityRoom02: STEM: Oh? Is the responsible Bao considering mischief?
DialogueDictionary.$GravityRoom03: BAO: No! I merely wish to observe the <![CDATA[<color=orange>Gravity Controls</color>]]> more closely!
DialogueDictionary.$GravityRoom04: STEM: Well, either way, I think I have something that might interest you. Meet me at our spot (Under the stairs in the <![CDATA[<color=orange>Ancient City</color>]]>). Bring Leersi!
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestCairnA: Escall: You and your clan disappeared without trace. We hope your journey took you far.
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestCairnB: Sai: You were taken by an untimely accident. We hope you learned what you wished.
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestCairnC: Curatella: You were taken by age. We thank you for the stories you told.
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestCairnD: Liche: You were taken by illness. We thank you for so bravely fighting disease in others.
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestCairnE: Hyssop: You were taken by age. I thank you for all you taught me.
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestFloorNearCairnE01: NEEM: I hope those memorialized here do not mind my addition: I miss you, Hyssop.
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestFloorNearCairnE02: NEEM: You were the one to make me choose my research field (History). It is strange to know you've become one of my study subjects - I hope my records of you can communicate even a fraction of your portent.
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestFloorNearCairnE03: <CRYING - TEENAGER TEXT> NEEM: The thought of you, my mentor, brings tears to my eyes. I so wish I could rewrite things. I so wish it was otherwise.
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestSignpost: Here we remember those who the past has taken from us.
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestNook01: STEM: And here is the end of your search!
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestNook02: BAO: A strange panel of metal? I hope you did not do all this for a bit of defective landscaping!
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestNook03: STEM: It’s a way into the <![CDATA[<color=orange>Service Tunnels</color>]]>! Now we can control gravity, not just the adults.
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestNook04: BAO: Do you even know how much trouble this will be for us? It’s catastrophic! How will Physalis ever accept me as his apprentice now?
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestNook05: STEM: So you won’t come with us to look at the controls up close?
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestNook06: BAO: ...You’re a terrible force upon me.
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestNook07: BAO (Thank you for showing me, Stem).
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestNook08: LEERSI: I’m sure he’ll understand, Bao. It’s Verat that worries me - the (other) adults will surely be annoyed he didn’t notice our secret...
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestRecorder01: ADENA: I suspect this is the last of your ancestor’s writing, Neem.
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestRecorder02: NEEM: It seems you are correct, my love. It’s strange, to miss someone I have never met (And who I share nothing with, other than the notion that a diminishing fraction of my genome stems from them).
DialogueDictionary.$MemorialForestRecorder03: ADENA: Hypothesis: It is that strangeness is exactly what is truly interesting, rather than the notion alone.
DialogueDictionary.$NOMAI_OBJECT_SLATE01: Slate: Oh, before you go, did you notice that thing <![CDATA[<color=orange>past</color>]]> the elevator?
DialogueDictionary.$NOMAI_OBJECT_SLATE02: Hornfels said it drifted into our solar system recently, <![CDATA[<color=orange>and</color>]]> doesn't seem to be a rogue planet.
DialogueDictionary.$NOMAI_OBJECT_SLATE03: They would appreciate it if you'd check it out in the near <![CDATA[<color=orange>future</color>]]>
DialogueDictionary.$Nookdial01: LEERSI: I think this is the spot, but I don't see Stem's clue...
DialogueDictionary.$Nookdial02: BAO: Perhaps we are mistaken. Their "clue" was hardly understandable anyway.
DialogueDictionary.$Nookdial03: LEERSI: Be kinder to them, Bao! They prepared this whole thing for us.
DialogueDictionary.$Nookdial04: STEM: Indeed, Bao is as cruel to me as a meteor against the ground...
DialogueDictionary.$Nookdial05: BAO: You're a meteor against my patience! Please, limit your dramatics to poetry.
DialogueDictionary.$Nookdial06: STEM: Yes, yes. Now, the next clue!
DialogueDictionary.$Nookdial07: STEM: "You solved my first riddle, but have you found..."
DialogueDictionary.$Nookdial08: STEM: "Where the starry <![CDATA[<color=orange>Jelly</color>]]> comes off the ground?"
DialogueDictionary.$Nookdial09: STEM: (I would advise asking Verat for help!)
DialogueDictionary.$Nookdial10: BAO: I would advise asking Acantha for protection, Stem.
DialogueDictionary.$PomaiHouseA01: FICUS: Even if this place is modelled after a time long before yours, I cannot help but think of you, ancestor Filix.
DialogueDictionary.$PomaiHouseA02: FICUS: I only know you existed because of the tragedy that took you from your sister (my many-great grandmother). I cannot see you, and yet I long to meet you. I wonder, did you ever imagine a descendant of yours would think of you?
DialogueDictionary.$PomaiHouseB01: GEUM: Acantha, is there anywhere I could learn more of the mundane life of our ancestors?
DialogueDictionary.$PomaiHouseB02: ACANTHA: Yes, Geum! I'm preparing for a lecture on just that. It's scheduled later today.
DialogueDictionary.$PomaiHouseB03: GEUM: You leave me little time to prepare questions! Though I'm sure you won't mind answering even long after the lecture.
DialogueDictionary.$PomaiHouseB04: GEUM: I find history too frequently focuses only on the great feats and impressive discoveries, ignoring the less surprising facts.
DialogueDictionary.$PomaiHouseC01: VERAT: Seeing this "city" finished, and seeing all the Nomai who visit our exhibit, I find myself more alone than ever before. This is the case even though I am surrounded by my clan, my mentor (Ophrys), and the friends I've made in other clans. I suspect others feel similarly.
DialogueDictionary.$PomaiHouseC02: GEUM: Suppose you miss your ancestors, Verat. If not your distant ones, then your grandmother, or grandfather.
DialogueDictionary.$PomaiHouseC03: VERAT: You might be right, Geum. I'll visit the memorial, in case anyone needs me.
DialogueDictionary.$PomaiHouseC04: VERAT: (Which is not to say I am unhappy with the result! All in our clan deserve pride in our achievement).
DialogueDictionary.$PomaiHouseC05: PHYSALIS: I understand the feeling well. Being surrounded by the past (or a facsimile of it), only makes it clearer who is no longer here.
DialogueDictionary.$PomaiHouseD01: OPHRYS: Although I trust Acantha's judgement, I cannot help but see the inaccuracies of the exhibit. We have not used the same tools to build the structures, nor the same materials.
DialogueDictionary.$PomaiHouseD02: OPHRYS: Even if these differences are invisible to the unaided eye (and very subtle to the aided one), something is missing in them. I suspect it's not something we can fix.
DialogueDictionary.$PomaiHouseD03: OPHRYS: I suspect the aspect in question is age]]>. Time has taken art, writing, discoveries, and techniques that we cannot emulate nor recreate; I believe it worthwhile to copy nonetheless.
DialogueDictionary.$PomaiHouseD04: OPHRYS: (At my insistence, as the originals are environmentally damaging to extract and use).
DialogueDictionary.$Radiotelescope01: GEUM: Physalis, sucrose, your electrical work here disappoints me. Anytime the cable conducts high amounts of energy, the door opens! Anyone could enter the <![CDATA[<color=orange>Scheduling Room</color>]]>!
DialogueDictionary.$Radiotelescope02: PHYSALIS: Apologies, love: Since the Festival began, I've not had a spare moment to improve it.
DialogueDictionary.$Radiotelescope03: PHYSALIS: (Although I trust my fellow Nomai enough not to fiddle with machinery without knowledge of what it does)
DialogueDictionary.$Radiotelescope04: GEUM: I would hope the fellow Nomai isn't Acantha.
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseRecord01: ADENA: Is Leersi not the name of one of your ancestors, my love?
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseRecord02: NEEM: Indeed it is! Of my great-great-grandmother, I believe.
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseRecord03: ADENA: It is so unusual to find undisturbed writing from so many generations ago. How do you feel?
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseRecord04: NEEM: I cannot deny it is strange, and I must admit I wish to see more of it. Hypothesis: Their clue hunt will prove the greatest source of my ancestor's writing. Would you indulge me in following it, my dear?
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall01: BAO: Stem, why did you ask to meet today? I remember you saying you'd be occupied.
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall02: STEM: And I was, Leersi! But now, it's ready.
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall03: LEERSI: I'd appreciate it if you were clearer...
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall04: STEM: I've made a <![CDATA[<color=orange>clue hunt!</color>]]> If you two solve it, you'll find my secret.
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall05: LEERSI: A <![CDATA[<color=orange>clue hunt?</color>]]> Why not just tell us?
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall06: STEM: I do not want any adult finding out. Besides, it'll be fun! Trust me!
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall07: LEERSI: So what is the first hint?
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall08: STEM: "When two after noon stretches the dial's shadow,"
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall09: STEM: "Go behind, away, until a small barrow."
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall10: BAO: You could have made it less obtuse, if you were kind.
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall11: STEM: My kindness is in wanting to share my discoveries, Bao!
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall12: BAO: Believe me, Leersi: To understand Stem might be the greatest discovery a Nomai can make.
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall13: STEM: Thank you for the compliment, friend.
DialogueDictionary.$Sundial01: OPHRYS: Many have pointed out the annoyance of visiting the Sundial any time they wish to know the internal time of the Exhibit. Not to mention, many (especially the younger Nomai) don't know how to read a sun clock!
DialogueDictionary.$Sundial02: VERAT: Would it be possible to paint hour-markers along the interior circumference of the shell?
DialogueDictionary.$Sundial03: PHYSALIS: I second Verat's proposal - on the condition it is not me who paints them.
DialogueDictionary.$Sundial04: GEUM: Would you be more willing if I offer to join you, Physalis?
DialogueDictionary.$Sundial05: OPHRYS: Please plan your romantic outings elsewhere, Geum...
DialogueDictionary.$Sundial06: ACANTHA: Your words worry me, Physalis! I will schedule a lecture on time-keeping as soon as I can.
DialogueDictionary.$Sundial07: PHYSALIS: Expressed like that, it does sound far more enjoyable.
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainRecorder01: ADENA: Neem, are you seeing this? What an impressive structure!
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainRecorder02: NEEM: I am, my love. To think that even after we have ceased our wandering, we are presented such a fascinating discovery.
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainRecorder03: ADENA: How old do you suppose it is? You are more familiar with our history than me.
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainRecorder04: NEEM: Centuries at the very least... I'm certain there is no living Nomai to have seen it in its prime.
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainRecorder05: ADENA: And it has endured in such condition! I cannot wait to see the ingenuity of our ancestors.
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainRecorder06: ADENA: Let us explore the <![CDATA[<color=orange>city</color>]]> in the center first.
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainHidingSpot01: BAO: Stem, I beg you! Why are you leading us in such a convoluted search?
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainHidingSpot02: STEM: Trust me, my friend! I don't want any adult finding my discovery (Not before you two do, at least).
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainHidingSpot03: STEM: Now, listen to the next clue:
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainHidingSpot04: STEM: "Go to where the trees grow so tall and so cold"
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainHidingSpot05: STEM: "Step on, to the edge, from where we name the old."
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainHidingSpot06: BAO: As much as I appreciate unravelling a mystery (even a constructed one), you could at least spare us from your poetry.
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainHidingSpot07: LEERSI: I enjoy the search, Bao. It is far more interesting than the geology lessons of Uncle Eucal.
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainScroll01: ACANTHA: Welcome all to our <![CDATA[<color=orange>Grand Exhibit</color>]]>, the centerpiece of my clan during this Festival!
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainScroll02: ACANTHA: Since our last reunion, we have been quite busy researching our history.
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainScroll03: ACANTHA: Please enjoy this recreation of our species' past! Explore at your leisure; snacks will be available at the central structure.
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainScroll04: ACANTHA: Of note: remember to periodically visit the <![CDATA[<color=orange>Exposition Hall</color>]]> for presentations and lectures.
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainScroll05: GEUM: The <![CDATA[<color=orange>Exposition Hall</color>]]> is also where our greatest find is exhibited!
DialogueDictionary.$WelcomeMountainScroll06: PHYSALIS: Including what (we believe) might have been the homeworld of our species, many millennia ago.
